sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday, looking to bounce back from their most recent loss. Sandbach remain top of the table with 22 points from 10 games despite that setback, and face a struggling Alsager side currently bottom of the division on just 4 points. This should be a strong opportunity for the leaders to return to winning ways at home.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture between mid-table sides, with Stafford on 20 points looking to maintain pressure on leaders Sandbach. AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a contest between two strong performers—Bridgnorth currently third with 19 points, Eccleshall fifth with 18. Wolverhampton Casuals, also on 19 points, face Wednesfield Community away in a match between sides in contrasting form, with Casuals recent winners but Wednesfield struggling in mid-table. Bilston Town travel to Foley Meir in a game between clubs separated by just one position, while Barnton host Shawbury United; the latter are in alarming form with five consecutive losses. Market Drayton Town face New Mills at home, both seeking consistency after mixed recent results. Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Crewe in a battle between struggling sides near the bottom of the table, and Brereton Social host Widnes Town, the division's bottom club on just 2 points. A midweek fixture follows on Wednesday with Brereton Social facing Wednesfield Community away.
